lead.event: Adaro Strategic transfers its ADRO and AADI stakes through negotiated-market transactions
lead.headline: Adaro Strategic transfers ADRO and AADI stakes in deals worth over Rp66 trillion
lead.blurb: Adaro Strategic Investments completed the negotiated-market transfer of its 48.7680% stake in Alamtri and 41.0965% stake in Adaro Andalan on 10 November. The stakes went to Trinugraha Thohir, Saratoga, Persada Capital Investama and Triputra Investindo Arya at Rp2,413 per ADRO share and Rp10,286 per AADI share. ASI said the ADRO transfer did not change control. Adaro Andalan’s disclosure also said its transfer did not change control.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: 4 new articles with a new fact: ASI said the ADRO transfer did not change control.

market_structure_policy.event: IDX expands its high shareholding concentration screening list
market_structure_policy.headline: IDX expands high shareholding concentration screening list to 383 stocks
market_structure_policy.blurb: The 300 additions represent 6.16% of JCI market capitalization, while the earlier 83 represented around 18% when their exclusion took effect. The revised test covers all listed stocks and flags those where 10 or fewer parties hold 92.5% or more of shares, removing the previous market-cap threshold and Price Impact Ratio requirement.

market_structure_policy.headline: IDX delists 18 issuers, including SRIL
market_structure_policy.blurb: Sritex was delisted on 10 November, alongside six other issuers classified as bankrupt; 11 more had been suspended for over 50 months. Under POJK No. 45 of 2024, issuers must buy back public shares, but the obligation may shift to controlling shareholders for specified corporate failures or violations.

macro_flows.event: Indonesia launches second panda bond offering
macro_flows.headline: Indonesia launches second panda bond offering targeting 12 billion yuan
macro_flows.blurb: The yuan-denominated issuance comprises three-, five- and seven-year series. Indonesia raised 7 billion yuan in its first offering in July and has approval to issue up to 30 billion yuan in China’s interbank bond market over two years.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Merdeka Battery Materials (MBMA) plans Rp2.5 trillion bond issuance
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: MBMA plans Rp2.5 trillion bond issuance
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Merdeka Battery Materials plans three fully committed series totaling Rp508.3 billion, with coupons of 9%, 10.25% and 10.75%; the remaining Rp2 trillion is on a best-effort basis. Proceeds from the committed portion will refinance the US$85.2 million still outstanding on Facility B, with any surplus for working capital. The offer runs 19-20 November, with listing scheduled for 26 November.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Andalan Artha Primanusa sets IPO price range
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: Andalan Artha Primanusa sets IPO price range at Rp158-Rp189 per share
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The offer comprises up to 1.676 billion new shares, equal to 25.10% of enlarged capital, and targets proceeds of up to Rp316.76 billion. Andalan Artha Primanusa plans to use 34.94% for debt repayment and the balance for working capital; bookbuilding runs through 17 November, ahead of a 24-27 November offering and 1 December listing.

deals_control.event: DOOH shareholders approve company transformation and corporate action package
deals_control.headline: DOOH shareholders approve transformation and rights issue of up to 154.78 billion shares
deals_control.blurb: Era Media Sejahtera shareholders approved CNI’s planned 29.88% INET purchase from Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara, subject to regulatory approval. A loan of up to Rp5 trillion from controlling shareholder Sinergi Internasional Investama will fund it. DOOH remains the ticker pending approval of the new name, Nexora Energy Infrastructure.

deals_control.event: Nawasena Nugra Investama acquires controlling stake in Idea Indonesia Akademi
deals_control.headline: Nawasena acquires 66.58% controlling stake in IDEA
deals_control.blurb: The 707.32 million shares were bought from President Director Eko Desriyanto and controlling shareholder Idea Asia Investama for Rp38 billion in total. Nawasena plans to expand and develop business activities through Idea Indonesia and will conduct a mandatory tender offer.

deals_control.event: CIMB Niaga raises ownership in Satyaguna Langgeng Capital through capital injection
deals_control.headline: BNGA raises Satyaguna ownership to 99.9998% through Rp365.28 billion injection
deals_control.blurb: CIMB Niaga contributed Rp365.28 billion in assets to Satyaguna Langgeng Capital, including Rp325.78 billion in bad loans and South Jakarta office property valued at Rp39.5 billion. OJK approved the transaction on 6 August 2026, and Commerce Kapital remains a minority shareholder with approximately 0.00020%.

deals_control.event: Mitra Agro Dharma Unggul increases its stake in Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera
deals_control.headline: Mitra Agro Dharma Unggul raises NSSS stake to 5.58%
deals_control.blurb: Mitra Agro Dharma Unggul bought 626.88 million Nusantara Sawit Sejahtera shares at Rp455 each on 6 November for Rp285.23 billion. Its voting rights rose from 2.95% to 5.58%, taking its holdings to 1.33 billion shares, though it said it is not a controlling shareholder.

earnings_guidance.event: BRI reports Q3 2026 results and receives analyst reactions
earnings_guidance.headline: BBRI reports Q3 profit of Rp16.8 trillion, up 16% year on year
earnings_guidance.blurb: Kiwoom Sekuritas Indonesia cut its 12-month target to Rp3,650 from Rp4,000 per share while maintaining a buy recommendation. JP Morgan cited improving micro asset quality but said Q3 net interest margin fell 73 basis points to 6.8%, which could weigh on net interest income in coming quarters.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

earnings_guidance.event: BRI Danareksa revises Astra International (ASII) forecasts and target price
earnings_guidance.headline: BRI Danareksa raises ASII’s 2026 profit forecast 5.3% to Rp29.1 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: BRI Danareksa Sekuritas also cut Astra International’s 2027 and 2028 net profit estimates by 2.1% and 5.2% to Rp33.1 trillion and Rp33.7 trillion. The revisions mainly reflect updated earnings estimates for United Tractors, which the broker expects to remain a key driver through Q4-2026 and 2027.

earnings_guidance.event: Mandiri Sekuritas raises Indofood forecasts and target price
earnings_guidance.headline: Mandiri Sekuritas raises INDF forecasts and target price to Rp 8,725
earnings_guidance.blurb: Indofood's FY2026 sales and core profit forecasts rose 6% and 9%, respectively, while 2027–2028 assumptions remained conservative amid potential El Niño-related commodity price increases. Mansek maintained its buy rating after nine-month sales rose 12% and core profit increased 11%.

earnings_guidance.event: Alfa Group retailers report nine-month 2026 performance
earnings_guidance.headline: AMRT and MIDI report nine-month 2026 revenue growth of 7.21% and 9.17%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Alfamart earned Rp2.4 trillion in net profit, up 3.79%, while Midi earned Rp705.57 billion, up 19.44%. Analysts cite defensive daily-needs retail and expansion, linking Midi’s higher profit growth to Lawson format optimization and digital synergy, and project further growth at both retailers.
